purpose: Prevent self-validation while allowing Core1/Core2 ordering to adapt to evidence.

phases.rule: The specialist receives original ground truth only and must not receive upstream specialist packets.
The blind-grounding packet is hashed and frozen before any upstream packet is revealed.
Only after the second specialist blind pass is frozen may the first specialist packet be revealed.
Every upstream claim must receive exactly one explicit comparison status grounded in original evidence.
Core1 semantic support and Core2 assessment demand may join only after relay validation closes.
